x: George Powell's win in the javelin, was our only success in the field events side and we also won the medley relay. In the junior match our only winner on the track was Alan Sexton in the 220 yards, but a new member in H.
One of the best performances was that of Harry Delger at the Kinnaird meeting when he threw the junior javelin about 154 feet to gain third place.
Alan Law's shot putting should still further improve. Paul Bowers and Harry Delger will be our Javelin throwers. For the Long Jump we shall have Ian Forrester, Brian Tillot and Nigel Cleeve.
